race.comment: CHARMING NIC (6) sat just off the speed and fought on well to finish second when resuming last start at this course and distance. Scored at his only other attempt second up. Bold showing anticipated. MISS MAHJONG (8) scored a barnstorming win last start over this track and trip, coming from the tail to get up by a head. Relishes the conditions here and is sure to be launching at the business end again. IT'S A YES (12) tested on a synthetic surface for the first time today on his return. Rates highly on his peaks and has jumped out sharply in readiness. Warrants consideration. SOLID SHALAA (1) made an encouraging return off a long break when resuming on the Pakenham syntho last time, warming into it nicely late. Better for that but may just need another.
